title: Settings
subtitle: Personalize the workspace and manage demo data.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose how FishAdmin looks on this device.

modes.lightDescription: Bright and clean, ideal for daytime work.
modes.darkDescription: Easy on the eyes in low light.

appearance.accentDescription: Used for primary actions, links and highlights.

shell.title: Shell
shell.description: Arrange the navigation, spacing and content width for your screen.

layouts.sidebarHint: Navigation in a collapsible left rail.
layouts.headerHint: Navigation in grouped menus across the top.
layouts.mixedHint: Icon rail on the left, the active group below the header.

densities.compactHint: Tighter spacing, more rows on screen.

shell.contentWidthDescription: How wide the page body may grow.

language.title: Language
language.description: Interface language. Dates and numbers follow the same locale.
language.label: Display language

security.title: Account security
security.description: Password, two-factor authentication and active sessions.

errorPages.title: Status page previews
errorPages.description: Full-page states you can wire into your own routing and error handling. Each preview opens in a new tab.

retention.title: Advanced data retention
retention.description: Review how long workspace records stay searchable before cleanup.
retention.note: Retention policies are illustrative in this demo. In production, configure them on the server so cleanup runs outside the browser.

demo.title: Demo data
demo.description: The demo stores users, roles and activity in your browser. Reset to restore the original seed.

dialog.title: Reset demo data?
dialog.description: All changes you made to users and roles will be lost, and the demo accounts will be restored.

about.title: About
about.builtWith: Built with React 19, TanStack Router, Tailwind CSS 4 and shadcn/ui.

storage.title: Local storage
storage.description: Theme, language, session and mock data are stored locally in this browser.
